caption: The drawing features a single bold, black symbol in the center of an off-white or cream-colored background. The symbol consists of a straight vertical line rising from a curved horizontal element. Near the top of the vertical line is a rounded, closed loop that forms a backward-facing letter "P." The lower portion of the shape extends horizontally with two pronounced curves, one curving upward and left, and the other downward and right, giving the appearance of a continuous, stylized line. In the upper left corner of the page, there is faint handwritten text that reads "PABLO ROMERO" and "PASTURA, N.M." The background is blank except for the described symbol and handwriting.
